summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  **What I found (read-only audit, no code touched):** The watchlist read/write path itself is actually built correctly — every route is scoped by the signed-in user's ID, there's no localStorage/anonymous fallback, and no hardcoded/default list. The real bug is one level up, in **login/signup email matching**, which is case-sensitive:  - Sign-up and login both compare email with a plain `=` lookup, and the `users.email` column's `UNIQUE` constraint is also case-sensitive (SQLite default). - So `Jane@Gmail.com` and `jane@gmail.com` are treate
